# `oaap app token`

deploy tokens of an instance: create, list, revoke.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app token {create,revoke,list} [name]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | -- |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `create` | yes |
| `revoke` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
